fields.description: Enable custom POS settings for this profile
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Select languages available in the POS language switcher. If empty, defaults to English and Arabic.
fields.label: Allowed Languages
Enable Customer Display
fields.description: Enable the customer-facing display screen feature

fields.label: Allow Account Creation
fields.description: Allow customers to create an account from the display screen

fields.label: Show Address Fields
fields.description: Show address fields in the customer creation form (both on display and in POS)
Customers scan the items of this till with their phone, from the shop's QR code, and the till takes their cart over. A shop till only.
fields.label: Let Customers Scan Their Items

fields.description: A phone's cart that is neither paid nor taken over by the till is deleted after this many hours.
fields.label: Abandoned Cart Lifetime (Hours)

fields.description: Set by the system the first time the shop's QR code is asked for: the code opens this till's shop page and nothing else.
fields.label: Key of the Shop's QR Code

fields.description: The customer may pay the cart on the phone, by the payment page the restaurant's guests pay on. A paid cart is always checked at the counter before the customer leaves.
fields.label: Pay on the Phone

fields.description: What an article a seller checks (ticked on the item or on its item group) does on the phone: the cart is paid at the till, or it is paid on the phone and the seller checks the article at the counter.
fields.label: An Article to Check, on the Phone
fields.options:
Blocks the payment
Paid, checked at the counter

fields.description: When enabled, POS will start in restaurant mode by default
fields.label: Default Restaurant Mode

fields.description: The restaurant this till works for
fields.label: Restaurant
Default Restaurant Table
fields.description: A table of direct service (a bar, a counter) this till opens on, and comes back to after each ticket. Empty: the till opens on the floor, as a waiter's pad does.
Enable takeaway orders in restaurant mode
fields.label: Enable Takeaway
Takeaway Card
fields.description: Optional: use a specific card with takeaway prices
The ticket of a table whose next course is ordered flashes on the kitchen screen until the kitchen starts it or leaves it to do
fields.label: Flash the ticket when the next course is ordered

fields.description: No longer used: the ticket flashes until the kitchen starts it or leaves it to do
fields.label: Popup stays (seconds)

fields.description: Show a notice at the top of the till when a guest orders or pays from the QR code of a table
fields.label: Popup when a guest orders

fields.description: Seconds the notice stays on the till. 0 = until somebody dismisses it. An order waiting for the waiter to validate it always stays until it is handled or dismissed
fields.label: Popup stays (seconds)

fields.description: Enable loyalty program features for this POS profile
fields.label: Enable Loyalty Program

fields.description: Loyalty program for this POS profile
fields.label: Loyalty Program

fields.description: Receivable account for customer wallets
fields.label: Wallet Account

fields.description: Automatically create wallet for new customers (always enabled when loyalty program is active)
fields.label: Auto Create Wallet

fields.description: Automatically convert earned loyalty points to wallet balance. Uses Conversion Factor from Loyalty Program (always enabled when loyalty program is active)
fields.label: Convert Loyalty Points to Wallet
Enable Gift Cards
fields.description: Enable gift card functionality in POS

fields.label: Gift Card Item
fields.description: Item that represents a gift card purchase. When sold, creates a gift card coupon with the item's price as the gift card value.

fields.label: Enable Gift Card Splitting
fields.description: When gift card amount exceeds invoice total, keep the remaining balance on the card for future use.

fields.label: Gift Card Validity (Months)
fields.description: Number of months a gift card is valid from creation date. Set to 0 for no expiration.

fields.label: Gift Card Notification
fields.description: Notification template to send when a gift card is created (e.g., email with gift card code).

fields.label: Closing Withdrawal Template
fields.description: Journal Entry Template used for cash withdrawal at shift closing. When set, cashiers can withdraw cash at closing and the remaining balance is suggested as next opening amount.
E-mail addresses (comma separated) that receive the end-of-day report as a PDF. Pre-filled in the send form; empty = the cashier's own address.
fields.label: End-of-Day Report Recipients

fields.description: Send the end-of-day report to these addresses as soon as a shift is closed.
fields.label: Send the End-of-Day Report Automatically

fields.description: Enable cart-wide discount
fields.label: Allow Additional Discount

fields.description: Enable item-level discount in edit dialog
fields.label: Allow Item Discount

fields.description: Allow user to edit item rate in cart. Rate editing is automatically disabled when promotional offers are applied to an item.
fields.label: Allow User To Edit Rate

fields.description: Show discounts as percentages
fields.label: Use Percentage Discount

fields.description: Maximum discount percentage (enforced in UI)
fields.label: Max Discount Percentage Allowed

fields.description: Allow customers to buy on credit (negative balance/debt)
fields.label: Allow Credit Sale

fields.description: Allow customers to use their positive credit balance (from returns/overpayments) as payment
fields.label: Allow Customer Credit Payment

fields.description: Enable product returns
fields.label: Allow Return

fields.description: Enable partial payment for invoices
fields.label: Allow Partial Payment

fields.description: When enabled, non-cash payments (card, bank transfer) require exact amount. Cash payments can still have change. Cannot be used with Credit Sale or Partial Payment.
fields.label: Use Exact Amount for Non-Cash

fields.description: Tips at a shop till: when a customer pays more than the total, the difference can become a tip, kept apart from the turnover on a transit account and given to the person who served (a restaurant till has its restaurant's own settings).
fields.label: Enable tip management

fields.description: The overpayment is entered as the tip straight away; the cashier can correct or cancel it before validating. Off, the cashier turns the change into a tip with a button.
fields.label: The overpayment becomes the tip

fields.description: Person who served: the tip is shared between the people of the sale, each for their part of it. Common pot: one tip that is nobody's, shared out by the salon.
fields.label: The tip goes to

fields.description: Made when tips are switched on
fields.label: Tip item

fields.description: Made when tips are switched on: the transit account (2211) the tips are booked on, not turnover
fields.label: Tip account

fields.description: Disabled: No sales person selection. Single: Select one sales person (100%). Multiple: Select multiple with allocation percentages.
fields.label: Sales Persons Selection

fields.description: Off: only services ask who did the work. On: a product sold asks who sold it, and counts in that person's statistics. Which items are products is told by the site (hook pos_next_item_kind); without it every line is a service.
fields.label: Track product sales by person too

fields.description: Show items in card view by default
fields.label: Default Card View

fields.description: Show item codes in the UI
fields.label: Display Item Code

fields.description: How many items each row of the grid shows. « Automatic »: as many as the width of the screen allows. A number: always that many, from 3 to 8; an item without a picture shows its name instead.
fields.label: Tiles per row

fields.description: On a phone, each button of the restaurant's card shows the item's picture above its name. Off: the name and the price only, so that more buttons fit on the screen.
fields.label: Pictures on a phone

fields.description: On the till, each tile of the restaurant's card shows the item's picture. Off: the name on the tile's colour, so that more tiles fit.
fields.label: Pictures on the till

fields.description: Each tile of the restaurant's card takes the colour of its item, else of its item group (the Service Colour of the group, set at the desk), on the till and on a phone.
fields.label: Colours of the tiles

fields.description: How tall the tiles of the restaurant's card are. « Compact »: short pictures, and a tile with no picture just high enough for its name, so that more tiles fit without scrolling. « Large »: square pictures.
fields.label: Tile height

fields.description: Each line of the cart is one row: the name, the quantity and the price, with the details under it, so that the whole order is seen at a glance. Off: the taller lines, the buttons under the name.
fields.label: Compact cart lines

fields.description: Each line of the cart shows the picture of the item, or its colour. Off: the name only, so that more of the name fits on the line.
fields.label: Pictures in the cart

fields.description: Display customer balance on screen
fields.label: Show Customer Balance

fields.description: Hide expected cash amount in closing
fields.label: Hide Expected Amount

fields.description: Show discount as percentage
fields.label: Display Discount %

fields.description: Show discount value
fields.label: Display Discount Amount

fields.description: Show item variants directly in the item grid instead of their template items. When disabled, template items are shown and variants are selected via a variant selector.
fields.label: Show Variants as Items

fields.description: Show most recently added item at the top of the cart
fields.label: LIFO Cart Order (Newest on Top)

fields.description: Enable sales order creation
fields.label: Allow Create Sales Order

fields.description: Select from existing sales orders
fields.label: Allow Select Sales Order

fields.description: Don't create invoices, only orders
fields.label: Create Only Sales Order

fields.description: Process returns without invoice reference
fields.label: Allow Return Without Invoice

fields.description: Number of days allowed for invoice returns. Set to 0 for unlimited returns.
fields.label: Return Validity Days

fields.description: Print invoices before submission
fields.label: Allow Print Draft Invoices

fields.description: Number of decimal places for amounts
fields.label: Decimal Precision

fields.description: Automatically set taxes as included in item prices. When enabled, displayed prices include tax amounts.
fields.label: Tax Inclusive

fields.description: Accept customer purchase orders
fields.label: Allow Customer Purchase Order

fields.description: Permit duplicate customer names
fields.label: Allow Duplicate Customer Names

fields.description: Automatically apply eligible coupons
fields.label: Auto Fetch Coupon Gifts

fields.description: Reprint the last invoice
fields.label: Allow Print Last Invoice

fields.description: Print without dialog
fields.label: Enable Silent Print

fields.description: Enable delivery fee calculation
fields.label: Use Delivery Charges

fields.description: Automatically calculate delivery fee
fields.label: Auto Set Delivery Charges

fields.description: Limit search results for performance
fields.label: Use Limit Search

fields.description: Maximum number of search results
fields.label: Search Limit Number

fields.description: Submit invoices in background
fields.label: Allow Submissions in Background Job

fields.description: Delete offline saved invoices
fields.label: Allow Delete Offline Invoice

fields.description: Modify invoice posting date
fields.label: Allow Change Posting Date

fields.description: Show quantity input field
fields.label: Use QTY Input

fields.description: Enable selling items even when stock reaches zero or below. Integrates with ERPNext negative stock settings.
fields.label: Allow Negative Stock

fields.description: Lock the POS screen after a period of inactivity. Each person opens it with the personal till code they set, or with their password
fields.label: Enable Session Lock

fields.description: Minutes of inactivity before the session is locked
fields.label: Session Lock Timeout (minutes)

fields.description: Lock at once when the browser tab or the phone's screen is left. Unticked, the lock waits for the delay above without use
fields.label: Lock as soon as the screen is left

fields.description: 0 = the site's session length. The session stays open while the device is used within this time.
fields.label: Keep staff signed in (days)
